items.title: Prove connection to the managed visible Demo client
evidence: 2026-09-20T10:03Z hash-bound Session2 one-shot probe result sha256:9477d34d320e019942608805fee171899fa51ff9714680ab2966c7f703c70eed: correct Demo/AUD account scope; positions=0; pending_orders=0; no terminal inventory change; Windows child-process restriction verified. It reported terminal_trade_allowed=false and attribution=UNVERIFIED because Session0 terminal PID 15056 remained alongside interactive PID 6440. This is connection observation, not ownership proof.

2026-09-20T10:34Z staged, uninstalled runner and audit-bridge payloads verified on T480. The Interactive, no-MT5 runner isolation spike completed (task result 0): it prestarted the fixed WSL audit bridge, applied the runner child-process restriction, made two fixed load-open-positions audit calls, and reaped the runner. Result marker FOREX_M30_AUDIT_ISOLATION_SPIKE_OK, counts 0/0, mt5_called=false, broker_mutation=NONE. This proves the proposed audit compatibility mechanism, not MT5 attachment or recovery.

2026-09-20T10:59Z a hash-bound S4U Session0 probe (result sha256:cdc7f793c6ad810d7b46eb4fb3c3d4f3a2b8af2a3a4f4dd6fea9805ed33e3a21) observed the approved hashed Demo account scope, zero positions, zero pending orders, an unchanged two-terminal inventory, and verified child-process restriction. It is explicitly SESSION_SCOPED_NOT_PID_BOUND, not native PID ownership.

2026-09-20T11:07Z the restricted staged runner/audit bridge returned FOREX_M30_PRE_ISOLATION_READINESS: durable_open_positions_count=0 and unresolved_execution_attempts_count=0. The listener was in fresh MAINTENANCE_HOLD with monitor IDLE and no assessment in flight. An initial readiness run failed closed because the new fixed command was absent from the runner allow-list; the one-identifier repair was tested and restaged before this successful result. No terminal or broker mutation occurred.

2026-09-20T11:29Z--11:41Z Session0 isolation completed with broker_mutation=NONE and retained outcome sha256:0d0e1bc65783d857c4bafbeb34b7a776e9e29d7fd4da06e7f21c14bf28fee258 (Session0 pre-observation) / isolation task result run_id=8a17330e8c6b416d8442cd553f16b19f. Both former S4U tasks are Disabled, hold remains present and diagnostics show no Forex listener Python process. Exactly one configured terminal remains: PID 6440 in Session2. A child-restricted post-isolation probe then returned INITIALIZE_FAILED without inventory change. An attach-only variant was terminated at its fixed 60-second bound without an output record; postflight still found the sole Session2 terminal and no listener process. This proves isolation/no replacement but not MT5 API attachment, permissions, account observation, or native PID binding.

2026-09-21T05:57:01Z--05:57:33Z after a report that T480 access was restored, three fixed read-only operations (m20_listener_status, m20_listener_terminal_identity, and m20_listener_terminal_capability) each failed with an SSH connect timeout to 192.168.0.210:22. Raw adapter outputs are under runs/local/m30-single-client-recovery/t480-access-20260921T055701Z/. No remote task, terminal, listener, or broker action was reached or changed. This leaves the connection observation unverified.

2026-09-22T01:54Z restricted post-isolation probe result sha256:ee65973a194b3ac903e9f81c907f91f192dccfd2bd8ae5548ddc550e44a26afa retained under runs/local/m30-single-client-recovery/post-isolation-probe-0rfEioHP/: one configured terminal PID 6440 in Session2 with unchanged before/after inventory and child restriction verified. MT5 initialize returned numeric error -10003 (internal IPC initialization/no IPC). No broker mutation occurred. The current fixed terminal-capability reader separately observed connected GOMarketsMU-Demo/AUD with terminal_trade_allowed=true, terminal_tradeapi_disabled=false, account permissions true and submission_permitted=true. This proves permissions and isolates an interactive scheduled-task IPC failure; it does not prove attachment.

2026-09-22T01:57Z unrestricted bounded comparison under the same current isolation guards ran until its scheduled-task limit (last_result=267014) without retaining an observation. Postflight retained under runs/local/m30-single-client-recovery/unrestricted-comparison-*/ still found exactly configured terminal PID 6440 in Session2, no listener worker, and broker_mutation=NONE. A fresh approved account reader observed GOMarketsMU-Demo/AUD with open_positions=0 and balance/equity equal. Both restricted and unrestricted interactive task variants therefore fail to attach while the SSH-context reader works.

2026-09-22T02:03Z after Chris manually restarted the visible MT5 client, the bounded child-restricted Session2 probe completed: retained observation sha256:80171587ab6894320599d9b79cae51b0454de05d773bb502d1493edc0ba6720e under runs/local/m30-single-client-recovery/after-client-restart-j9sATwUz/. It observed the approved GOMarketsMU-Demo/AUD account scope, terminal_connected=true, terminal_trade_allowed=true, terminal_tradeapi_disabled=false, account permissions true, zero positions/pending orders and unchanged pre/post inventory containing only configured terminal PID 16412 in Session2. attribution=SESSION_SCOPED_NOT_PID_BOUND and broker_mutation=NONE. This proves the bounded intended-client connection; it does not prove native PID attachment or closure/reopening recovery.

items.title: Prove client closure and reopening behaviour

Two fixed identity observations six seconds apart retained under runs/local/m30-single-client-recovery/client-closed-AkSOwq2s/ found terminal_processes=[] and listener_processes=[]; the current-guarded probe refused before MT5 initialization with sole visible terminal required. No replacement process or broker mutation occurred.

2026-09-22T02:55Z after Chris reopened the visible client, two child-restricted Session2 probes retained under runs/local/m30-single-client-recovery/client-reopened-*/ observed the same configured PID 21520, correct GOMarketsMU-Demo/AUD account scope, zero positions/pending orders, enabled permissions and unchanged pre/post inventory. Observation SHA-256 values are 564fae22158c4e2c07f2ac1d8431ec17c6bd93140d50dbdd490ca5eabd2a6ada and e781f734ff89a652086f7a89f9783c8ea50e3ef8a2854a7a29cd5cea0f9a5cfb. broker_mutation=NONE.

2026-09-22T02:58Z close-during-connect race result sha256:d34cdb12ad018b819aacd9d9738ab8d13c044d4d0373114b01c370247f9b1471 retained under runs/local/m30-single-client-recovery/close-race-nP9FsOIy/: before inventory contained only configured Session2 PID 21520; after Chris closed MT5 during the fixed 30-second child-restricted delay, after inventory was empty. This proves the tested close-during-connect behaviour fails safely with no replacement terminal.
